What Is Physician Billing

Physician billing is the process of seeking payment for healthcare services physicians provide.

Physician billing covers generating medical claims and submitting them to insurance companies. Billers gather information, generate correct claims, verify them, and send them to payers so the physician gets paid. PMEX Physician Billing Services handle every step, from coding to electronic submission to reimbursement follow-up.

The physician billing landscape is a maze of complex rules and regulations. One tiny misstep could mean lost payments or penalty fines. PMEX takes the stress out of this administrative maze so physicians can focus entirely on patient care.

MIPS Quality Reporting

MIPS Optimization

Optimize MIPS by Over 75 Points with PMEX Physician Billing

Medicare's MIPS program incentivizes high-quality care. The performance threshold is 75 points. Scores below lead to negative payment adjustments; scores above result in positive adjustments by Medicare. The swing is up to 9% of your reimbursements either way.

PMEX Physician Billing knows the MIPS program inside out. We help you hit over 75 points in quality reporting. Our team works tirelessly to optimize your scores across all four MIPS categories: Quality, Promoting Interoperability, Improvement Activities, and Cost.
